description: This file defines the EmailConfiguration entity class for the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for mapping to the database table 'ohrm_email_configuration' and includes properties for various email and SMTP configuration settings, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: EmailConfiguration
classes.description: Entity class representing email configuration settings with ORM mappings for database storage.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the email configuration.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the email configuration.

methods.name: getSentAs
methods.description: Retrieves the sender information for emails.

methods.name: setSentAs
methods.description: Sets the sender information for emails.
